name.la: Responsio ad librum inscriptum Triplici nodo triplex cuneus
name.en-US: Reply to Triplici nodo, triplex cuneus
name.pt-BR: Resposta ao Triplici nodo, triplex cuneus

description.la: Responsio Matthaei Torti ad librum Jacobi regis (1608). Textus ex editione Vivès (1870-74), tomo XII, ex scanno OCR.
description.en-US: The reply of "Matthaeus Tortus" to the book of James I, on the oath of allegiance (1608). Latin only: the Vivès edition (1870-74), volume 12, from an OCR scan.
description.pt-BR: A resposta de "Matthaeus Tortus" ao livro de Tiago I (1608).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 12 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
